text:
Marin: Heads-up — want to lock the changelog and docs links for next week's release. Target window: post-webinar rehearsal tomorrow. Who can take link-freeze by EOD?
Sam: I can land the final changelog PR today. Expect merge by 4pm PT.
Noah: Drafted anchors and added the doc section. Link preview: https://redwood.ai/docs/releases/3.2.3-changelog
Sam: Will point marketing to that canonical URL after merge. @deploy-bot can you hold any scheduled pub until we confirm canary is clean?
deploy-bot: Release notice queued for 2025-08-01T17:00:00Z. Use `/release cancel` to stop.
Tia: Webinar rehearsal confirmed 10:00–10:30am PT. Let's avoid public posts until after 10:45am PT so we can capture live metrics.
Marin: Sounds good. Marketing needs: 1-line headline, 3 bullets for the blog, and a short tweet thread. I'll draft those once the changelog link is final.
Noah: Blog blurb (v0): "More efficient inference routing, reduced token cost with smarter batching, and expanded Private KMS options. Full notes: https://redwood.ai/docs/releases/3.2.3-changelog"
Lana: I'll slot that into the webinar slide deck. Need the perf chart and one hero screenshot — can someone drop them in #assets?
Sam: Uploading perf graph to #assets in ~10m (`/files/ci/perf-aug2025.png`). It's the 99p latency vs previous rollout.
Marin: Also adding an embargo line to the release doc: DO NOT PUBLISH before 10:45am PT on Aug 1. Put it in the doc header.
Noah: Embargo added and pinned in the doc.
Sam: PR merged (16:12 PT). Canonical changelog URL is live: https://redwood.ai/docs/releases/3.2.3-changelog
Marin: Great — we'll prepare the blog draft with placeholders for the final numbers. Who's watching the canary during rehearsal?
Sam: Eng oncall (Sam) and Riya from Eng-SRE will monitor. I'll post status updates at +5m and +15m after canary starts.
Tia: If we see regressions, abort announcement flow and follow the rollback checklist at https://redwood.ai/internal/runbooks/canary-fallback
Marin: Ok marketing will queue posts but hold publish. I'll ping when blog + social copy are queued and linked.
Sam: 👍
deploy-bot: Announcement dispatched to #public at 2025-08-01T17:01:02Z
Marin: Nice. Can we get a live dashboard screenshot for the blog header? Sam — thanks for uploading.
Sam: Uploaded live dashboard: /files/screens/live-aug01.png
Lana: Final check: changelog link verified, embargo present, canary watchers set, assets in place. Syncboard updated. :raised_hands:
Marin: Closing loop — marketing will be on standby. Ping here if anything changes.
